Question Choices: If each crate has 9 oranges and there are 4 crates. How many oranges in total?
Hints: This is 4 crates with 9 oranges each, so it is 4 x 9 or 9 + 9 + 9 + 9
Solution: Four crates each contain nine oranges. Add 9+9+9+9 = 36 oranges.
